```yaml
severity: "ERROR"
message: "Potential error in reading bytes from the bytestream."

  type: "security"
  securityType: "informationLeakage"
  cwe: ["CWE-209"]
  cve: ["CVE-2022-31124"]
  tags: ["openssh", "key", "parser"]
pattern: '''(?x)
    ^
    (?=.*?\bEOFError\b)
    (?=.*?\bread_fixed_bytes\b)
    (?=.*?\bnum_bytes\b)
    .*
'''
```

This rule will match any code that mentions the words "EOFError", "read_fixed_bytes" and "num_bytes". The pattern is a regular expression (regex) that matches any line of code that contains these keywords. 

Please note that this is a very basic example, and it might not cover all possible ways in which the vulnerability could be triggered. You may need to adjust the regex or add more checks depending on how exactly the vulnerability manifests itself in your specific use case.
